name: MGH/MF Waveform Database: Multi-Parameter ICU Hemodynamics
description: The Massachusetts General Hospital / Marquette Foundation (MGH/MF) Waveform Database is a pioneering critical care monitoring repository recorded in the intensive care units of Massachusetts General Hospital. It contains 250 multi-channel physiological recordings from 250 adult patients admitted to cardiac and surgical ICUs, with recording durations typically ranging from 12 to 24 hours. Signals include 3 continuous ECG leads (leads I, II, and V), arterial blood pressure (ABP), central venous pressure (CVP), pulmonary arterial pressure (PAP), and airway respiration. Expert clinicians provided comprehensive annotations for cardiac arrhythmias, hemodynamic state shifts, and catheter calibration events.
